notes.title: Version 1.0.0.16 Patch Notes & Dev Letter about English Version
notes.content:
Official Version V1.0.0.16 Update Content:

【Experience Optimizations】
[olist]
[*] Added 64 new sets of story character portraits. The portrait selection interface now supports long-press for quick switching.
[*] Added support for leaving the Assassin Organization.
[*] Messenger Pigeons now display the real-time coordinates of the relevant NPC.
[*] Added a secondary confirmation dialogue for Martial Arts Sparring with story NPCs.
[*] The in-game system menu now supports opening the local log directory. This automatically opens when reporting issues.

[*] Factions now support the relocation of their headquarters. Adjusted the logic for alliance disbandment.
[*] Optimized the performance of the Faction Member interface to prevent lag when there are many members.
[*] Added the display of Faction Level to the Faction Relationship list.
[*] The Faction interface now responds to the ESC key to exit.
[*] Faction members dispatched for expeditions can no longer take on labor jobs.
[/olist]

【Bug Fixes】
[olist]
[*] Fixed an issue preventing combat under the Spanish regional setting.
[*] Fixed the logic for switching and saving between two sets of key bindings.

[*] Fixed an issue where Willpower dropped to 0 for story NPCs after being captured.
[*] Fixed an issue where many random NPCs knew sword, blade, and spear martial arts but not fist techniques, yet had no weapon equipped.
[*] Fixed an issue where resource gathering always yielded only 1 unit.
[*] Fixed the patrol route for Capital City Constables.

[*] Fixed an issue where Faction Prisoners lacked the "Recruit as House Servant" dialogue option.
[*] Fixed abnormal dialogue for Faction Prisoners after they become house servants.

[*] Corrected the Light Kung Fu/Internal Kung Fu martial arts and Friendship Lists for Sandbox story NPCs.
[*] Corrected dialogue content and options for Sandbox story NPCs.
[*] Fixed an issue where Sandbox story NPCs did not revert to their original portraits after their Mod portraits were deprecated.

[*] Fixed the issue in the [Eternal Ambition] quest where Song Hongyu was not moved.
[*] Fixed the incorrect corpse coordinates for Tianxiaren in [Shattered Heavens].
[*] Modified the quest guidance text for [Unification of Heluo], adding a prompt indicating the need to complete [The Nation's Secret].
[*] Fixed a typo in [The Trail of the False Hero].
[*] Fixed an issue where some saves with [Enlightened Resolve · II] guidance could not accept the quest.
[*] Corrected the coordinates for Tuoba Xiao and Shen Wuxia in Sandbox mode.

[*] Fixed configuration errors for some martial arts and common moves.
[*] Fixed an issue where non-Sect NPCs were using Sect martial arts techniques.
[/olist]

Since most of the bugs for the official version have been largely addressed, subsequent updates won't be as frequent as the initial bug-fixing phase right after launch. We will return to the previous schedule of one major update per month or one every two months.
Finally, thank you all for your support. 

Wishing everyone have a good  Dragon Boat Festival! ^_^

[hr][/hr]
Dear Players, 
We want to be fully transparent about the delays in releasing the English version of Path of Kung Fu. The main challenge comes from our early development approach—significant amount of the game’s text were hardcoded into the game systems rather than being set up for easy localization. 

What This Means for Development: 
1.A massive amount of content must be manually extracted. 
2.Each system (quests, UI, items) requires separate refactoring. 
3.Localization now involves restructuring parts of the core code. 

We're simultaneously working on finalizing game content and optimizing player experience. It`s taking more time than our expect,and we are actively working on it.

A Heartfelt Thank You 
We’ve received many kind offers from players willing to help with translation. We’re deeply moved by your passion for Path of Kung Fu! Unfortunately, due to the technical hurdles mentioned above, we can’t yet provide text files for community translation. Once the extraction is complete, we’ll explore ways to involve you in polishing the localization. 
Your patience and support mean the world to us. We’ll keep you updated on our progress, and we’re committed to delivering a version that meets your expectations. 

With gratitude, 
Path of Kung Fu Team

notes.title: The English and other language versions are currently being repaired.
notes.content:
[b]To All Heroes,[/b]

——————————————————
Dear players,
Please be aware that the non-Chinese versions of our content are currently machine-translated and as such, may contain some errors and inaccuracies. Additionally, we found some text appears untranslated due to our technical issues.

We are actively working to resolve these problems as quickly as possible. However, providing translations will take some time, and we are also addressing other bugs. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

We truly appreciate your understanding, patience, and continued support during this time. 
Once again, we apologize for any disruptions and thank you for being with us.
——————————————————

First and foremost, we extend our deepest gratitude to every player who has chosen to experience Path of Kung Fu. A special thanks goes to our pioneering early access players who have supported us since the EA phase. It is your encouragement and companionship that have allowed the Path of Kung Fu development team to grow and progress.

Four years ago, driven by my passion for wuxia and real-time combat, I embarked on this project. Most of our team members are avid fans of martial arts fiction, having been captivated decades ago by the world of chivalry, love, vengeance, and heroism depicted in wuxia novels. Back then, I often wondered—if I could wield a sword and ride freely through the land, what kind of journey would I embark upon?

That long-held dream has now taken shape in your hands as Path of Kung Fu.

In the story, players are drawn into a bloody feud with the Northern Jackals after an unexpected kidnapping in Nameless Market. In Qingping Village, they catch a glimpse of the chaos plaguing the world. As they travel across the land, they gradually uncover the origins of their unique constitution, unravel the mysteries of the Imperial Guards who once dominated the martial world, and rise from obscurity to become a pivotal figure capable of reshaping the jianghu—even altering the fate of the empire itself. At the climax, faced with a decades-long conspiracy, how will the player make their move?

Will they pledge allegiance to the court in pursuit of unparalleled glory? Will they dominate the martial world as its sovereign? Or will they retire to the mountains with their loved ones, laughing over tales of their adventures? The choice lies in a single thought.

For thousands of years in China, from The Biographies of the Knights-Errant to modern writers’ depictions of "chivalry," the concept of xia has formed a shared imagination among generations of youths—a world of unrestrained heroism, where honor is repaid without regard for fame or fortune. This world, bold and free, has echoed through history and into the present.

Path of Kung Fu hopes to present such a world, where one lives by their heart. Perhaps the jianghu is a place of both purity and corruption, where grudges and debts are hard to define, and the path of righteousness is fraught with hardship. Yet countless souls, across time and space, will take that first step in pursuit of justice.

If the light of chivalry in this world dims and flickers, why not let me raise a lone lantern?

The Path of the Righteous Shall Never Be Walked Alone.

[b]With Respect,
Path of Kung Fu Development Team[/b]

————————————————————
[h3][b]Early Access to Full Launch[/b][/h3]

After more than 7 months in Early Access, with nearly 30 updates and 3 major version updates, Path of Kung Fu is officially leaving Early Access. The main storyline is now complete (with 5 possible endings), and we've added more open world content. 

Note: Steam Deck compatibility will follow post-launch. Current performance may vary.

Full Version Content
Main & Side Quests
• 15 large maps (5 sects) and additional smaller maps.

Clan Features

NPC Interactions

Other gameplay

Future Roadmap

Standard Mode includes all gameplay content.

notes.title: About the prompt "Please log back into steam and restart the game"
Developer Plan 1: Early Access Release Plan
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Since we first mentioned our plans for an Early Access (EA) release, many players have asked us questions like, "What is EA?" and "Why choose this method?" Today, we’d like to share our thoughts with you.

[h1]What is Early Access?[/h1]

For those familiar with indie games, EA might not be a new term. According to Steam’s official definition, EA is: "A tool that allows the community to experience the game before its official release and gives customers the understanding that the product is ‘unfinished’ but has [b]a playable state[/b] with plans for continued development."

In simpler terms, EA is when a game is not fully completed but already has playable content. It is released in this state using the Early Access model.

[h1]Why use this approach?[/h1]

Steam explains that EA helps "bring the community into the development process and provides the developer with funding to complete the game." This perfectly fits our situation.

[h2]A Beneficial Cycle[/h2]

Players who have been in our community from the start will notice that the current version of the game is vastly different from the early versions. Initially, the [u]combat difficulty, controls, and UI[/u] were very "rough" (some might say user-unfriendly). This stemmed from our early "closed-door" development approach. Daojian Jianghu Lu is also our team’s [b]first[/b] indie game, and we quickly realized this wasn’t the best method.

Once we opened the demo, the first wave of players joined our chat groups and provided [b]invaluable and practical suggestions[/b]. The game has steadily improved through this [b]positive feedback loop[/b]. We learned that engaging with the player community keeps the game [b]on the right development path[/b], creating a win-win for both developers and players. (PS: Our three active chat groups are full as I write this, with players who have earned [u]top activity badges[/u], proving we’ve been listening to your feedback.)

While this is a bold project for our first game (in terms of development costs), Daojian Jianghu Lu is still an indie game, not a AAA title. We mention this not to excuse any shortcomings but to acknowledge that we still have a long way to go. Rather than letting expectations [b]skyrocket[/b] while we [b]"promise more and more,"[/b] we’d rather put the game in your hands now so we can all continue building this wuxia dream together.

[h2]Practical Considerations[/h2]

We’ve often mentioned the content included in the EA version—700,000 characters of narrative, 24 martial arts styles, 12 light movement techniques, 17 internal arts, 3 story-driven sects, and many more open-world features (baby raising, companion and servant development, etc.). These account for about 55% of the full release, which is expected to launch in Q3 2025.

However, our current development costs have reached the [b]limit[/b] of what we can handle. Our loyal fans know that our lead developer, Laomeng, has taken on loans and mortgages to push the game to this point. As this is our first game, it was a very bold decision. Using Early Access will help us gather the funding needed to complete the game.

[h1]What content can you expect in the EA version?[/h1]

It seems we can't avoid this lengthy explanation. The EA version includes:

10 large maps
700,000 characters of narrative
24 martial arts styles
12 light movement techniques
17 internal arts
3 story-driven sects
Open-world features like factions, child-rearing, companion and servant development, brothel gameplay, martial arts schools, bounty hunting, prison break, and more NPC interactions.
This content covers about 55% of the full version. If you find these [u]descriptions a bit abstract[/u], our demo will remain available for you to experience firsthand. You can try it and then decide if the content aligns with your expectations.

[b]We emphasize content details to ensure players have a clear understanding of what the EA version offers.[/b]

[b]The EA version focuses mainly on story and combat, with less open-world sandbox gameplay. If you're mainly interested in the open-world features, we recommend waiting for the full release.[/b]

[h2]Post-EA Update Plan[/h2] We’ll provide a detailed update plan after the EA release.

notes.title: Path of Kung Fu - FAQ - Frequently Asked Questions (Continuously Updated)
notes.content:
Q: What kind of game is "Path of Kung Fu"? 
A: It is a buy-to-play, wuxia-themed, side-scrolling action RPG with real-time combat. The game features a rich narrative and intense martial arts combat, aiming to immerse players in a dark, intrigue-filled world of martial arts and revenge.

Q: How much content is there?
 A: The EA version includes 10 large maps, 700,000 characters of narrative text, 24 martial arts styles, 12 light movement techniques, 17 internal arts, 3 story-driven sects, as well as open-world factions, having children and raising them, companion development, servant development, brothel gameplay, martial arts schools, San Cai books, bounty hunting, prison break, and more NPC interactions. This content represents about 55% of the full version. If the description feels abstract, you can try the demo, which will remain available for you to experience firsthand before deciding to purchase.

Q: What is the story setting of the game?
 A: The story is structured around different regions, each with its own story arc, which eventually weaves into a broader narrative as you explore more areas.

Q: Can players fully control the story direction? 
A: No, players can influence the outcome of some events in the EA version, but it’s not like "Baldur’s Gate 3," where every choice branches into different subplots. We will add multiple endings to some side quests, but the overall story will remain linear.

Q: What is the pricing for the EA version? 
A: The game is priced at 58 RMB in China, with a launch week discount of 52.2 RMB. Pricing for other regions can be checked in the store.

Q: How long is the EA version gameplay? 
A: Just following the main story and combat is estimated at 30+ hours. If you engage with the open-world interactions and random NPC gameplay, the playtime could be much longer.

Q: Why an EA release? 
A: You can refer to our development plan here: [link]

Q: When will the Creative Workshop be available? 
A: It will be introduced around three months after EA launch, depending on the game’s stability.

Q: Can EA version save files carry over from the demo? 
A: No, due to significant changes in early data, demo saves will not carry over (to prevent bugs).

Q: Will EA saves carry over to the full release? 
A: Yes.

Q: Does the game support Steam Deck or other handheld consoles? 
A: We haven’t tested compatibility specifically. Please provide feedback if you encounter issues.

Q: What controls are supported? 
A: Keyboard and mouse are supported. Controller support is still being refined. Please report any issues you encounter.

Q: What is the post-EA update plan? 
A: [Link to update plan]

Q: What if the loading bar gets stuck at two-thirds during game launch?
 A: Ensure the game was downloaded through Steam and update your graphics driver. If the problem persists, you can contact an admin through our community.

Q: The game crashes or freezes when entering combat. 
A: This is likely due to insufficient RAM. Try closing unnecessary programs or windows to resolve the issue.

Q: Where can I find the save file path? 
A: C:\Users\YourUsername\AppData\LocalLow\HuaLongZ (If you can’t find AppData, enable hidden items in the View tab.)

Q: How can I report a problem? 
A: During the launch period, we are receiving many reports. We recommend submitting your feedback via this form:
https://forms.gle/Ci5u6L7NxHpyjekv6
We will follow up promptly. For serious bugs (e.g., crashes), contact an admin in our community directly.
